cards.name: Live+
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.1,000 cashback on mobile-app login + Rs.20,000 spend within 30 days; voucher worth up to Rs.750 (Amazon Pay/Zomato/Swiggy) on activation; Rs.250 Amazon eGV for online application with video KYC.
cards.lounge_access: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits/year (1 per quarter). Reduced to 2/year (1 per half-year) from 26 Jul 2026.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, e-wallet loads, rent/property management, education, government payments, insurance, jewellery, gambling, tolls, financial institutions, money transfers, charity, wholesale clubs; hospitals (MCC 8062) and bus/subway transit (MCC 4111) added to exclusions from 26 Jul 2026.
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65 salaried / 25-65 self-employed; income Rs.6L p.a. salaried or Rs.12L p.a. self-employed; resident in ~20 eligible cities.
cards.notes: Formerly the HSBC Cashback Credit Card (rebranded Live+ in 2023). 10% accelerated cashback shares one Rs.1,000/billing-cycle cap across dining, food delivery and grocery; 1.5% base is uncapped. Devaluation effective 26 Jul 2026: lounge visits cut 4 to 2, two MCCs excluded; forex markup improves 3.5% to 1.99%. Cashback credited within 45 days of statement. Times Prime 12-month subscription complimentary.

cards.name: TravelOne
cards.welcome_benefit: On Rs.25,000 spend within 30 days: Rs.1,000 cashback + Rs.3,000 Postcard Hotel voucher + 3-month EazyDiner Prime; Rs.250 Amazon eGV with video KYC.
cards.milestone_benefits: 10,000 bonus reward points on annual spend above Rs.12,00,000.
cards.lounge_access: 6 domestic lounge visits/year (Mastercard) + 4 international visits/year (LoungeKey); no guest access.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, insurance, jewellery, education/government payments, e-wallets, financial institutions, money transfers, real estate, tax payments, utilities.
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65 salaried / 25-65 self-employed; income Rs.6L p.a. salaried or Rs.12L p.a. self-employed; resident in eligible cities.
cards.notes: rupee_per_point 1.0 assumes 1:1 instant transfer to ~20 airline/hotel partners (mile valued ~Re.1; Accor transfers can yield more); non-transfer redemptions are worth less. Accelerated 4x earning capped at 50,000 points/month (spend beyond earns base 2/100). 4 golf rounds + 12 lessons/year; purchase protection up to USD 20,000/year. Periodic 100% forex-fee cashback promos have run; standard markup is 3.5% + GST.

cards.name: Premier
cards.welcome_benefit: 20,000 reward points on card activation/first use.
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic and international lounge access for primary cardholder, plus 8 international guest visits/year.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% surcharge waived on fuel transactions of Rs.400-4,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard HSBC exclusions (fuel, wallets, government payments etc.); see MITC.
cards.eligibility: HSBC Premier relationship required: quarterly Total Relationship Balance Rs.50L, or net monthly salary credit Rs.3L, or Rs.1.15Cr mortgage + Rs.50L TRB within 12 months.
cards.notes: Fees (joining Rs.12,000, renewal Rs.20,000) are waived for customers who maintain Premier eligibility - waiver is relationship-based, not spend-based (fee_waiver_spend 0 = no spend route). Point value: 1:1 at Apple store and 1:1 instant transfer to airline/hotel partners (~Re.1/point). 'Up to 12X' (36/100) only via HSBC Travel with Points portal bookings. Rs.1Cr air-accident/travel insurance. Effectively invite/relationship gated.

cards.name: Taj Credit Card

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Taj / IHCL properties (Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta, Gateway, ama Stays)

cards.reward_currency: Reward Points (redeem to Taj wallet credit)
cards.welcome_benefit: Two breakfast-inclusive nights at Taj hotels in India + one night at Taj Palaces; NeuPass Taj InnerCircle Platinum tier membership; renewal voucher: one Taj Palaces night (valid 6 months, offer per terms to Sep 2026).
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited airport lounge access globally; Taj Chambers lounge access up to 12 times/year (cardholder + 1 guest).
cards.eligibility: Age 25-75; income Rs.36L p.a. salaried or Rs.45L p.a. self-employed; resident Indian (or existing HSBC India NRI account holder) in ~20 eligible cities.
cards.notes: Super-premium IHCL (Taj) co-brand launched 2024; India's highest-fee co-branded card. Redemption: 1.5 points = Re.1 Taj wallet credit (rupee_per_point ~0.67). Other perks: unlimited room upgrades, 25% F&B savings at IHCL, 12 golf games + lessons/year, 4 spa treatments/year, BOGO movies (2x/month, Rs.1,000 cap), 30% EazyDiner (Rs.1,500 cap), 50% Starbucks (Rs.150, 4x/month). Forex markup and exclusion list not published on product page - check MITC before relying on them.

cards.name: Visa Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 bonus points on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days (with app download); 3-month Swiggy One; voucher up to Rs.500 (Amazon Pay/Zomato/Swiggy) on activation; Rs.250 Amazon eGV with video KYC.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Surcharge waiver up to Rs.250/month on fuel transactions of Rs.400-4,000; promo Rs.250 cashback/quarter on contactless fuel payments up to Rs.10,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard HSBC exclusions (fuel, wallets, government payments etc.); see MITC.
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65 salaried / 25-65 self-employed; income Rs.6L p.a. salaried or Rs.12L p.a. self-employed; resident in eligible cities.
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Earns 2 points per Rs.150 (~1.33/100). Point value redemption-dependent and modest (~Rs.0.25 typical for catalog/travel redemptions; miles/hotel transfer available in-app) - rupee_per_point is an estimate, not bank-published. 'Up to 6X' points only via Travel with Points portal. Forex 3.5% per standard tariff (third-party sourced).

cards.name: RuPay Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 cashback on app login + Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days; Rs.250 cashback for linking UPI and making 2 transactions of Rs.250+ within 30 days; 2-month EazyDiner membership; Rs.250 Amazon eGV with video KYC.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Annual fuel-surcharge savings up to Rs.3,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard HSBC exclusions; UPI P2P and excluded MCCs earn nothing; see MITC.
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65 salaried / 25-65 self-employed; income Rs.6L p.a. salaried or Rs.12L p.a. self-employed; resident in eligible cities.
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Earns 2 points per Rs.150 (~1.33/100) including on UPI spends via linked apps. International acceptance via JCB network (160+ countries). Point value estimate ~Rs.0.25 (same rewards program as Visa Platinum); not bank-published. Forex markup not disclosed on product page.

cards.name: RuPay Cashback
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 cashback on app login + Rs.10,000 spend within 30 days; Rs.250 cashback for linking UPI and making 2 transactions of Rs.250+ within 30 days; 2-month EazyDiner membership; Rs.250 Amazon eGV with video KYC.
cards.lounge_access: Up to 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits/quarter and 2 international visits/year (RuPay/JCB network programs).
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard HSBC cashback exclusions (fuel, wallets, rent, government, insurance etc.); see MITC.
cards.eligibility: Age 18-65 salaried / 25-65 self-employed; income Rs.6L p.a. salaried or Rs.12L p.a. self-employed; resident in eligible cities.
cards.notes: 10% on dining/food delivery/grocery and 1% on other spends (incl. UPI) share a combined Rs.400 cap per statement cycle - low ceiling for heavy spenders. forex_markup_pct 0 reflects the promotional 0% FX markup valid until 31 Jul 2026 (via JCB); post-promo rate not published, expect standard tariff. Lounge benefit is network-program based and can change.

cards.name: Smart Value
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Annual fuel-surcharge savings up to Rs.3,000.
cards.notes: No longer sold to new customers (HSBC directs applicants to Live+ or Premier); existing holders retained. 3X (3/100) on online, dining and telecom capped at 1,000 bonus points/month. Point value estimate ~Rs.0.25.

cards.name: Platinum (MakeMyTrip co-brand)
cards.notes: MakeMyTrip travel co-brand, listed on HSBC's official discontinued-cards page; closed to new applicants. Current terms for any remaining holders not published - fields left null rather than guessed.

cards.name: Signature (MakeMyTrip co-brand)
cards.notes: Premium MakeMyTrip travel co-brand with accelerated rewards, listed on HSBC's official discontinued-cards page; closed to new applicants. Current terms not published - fields left null. (HSBC's discontinued page also lists long-closed Classic, Westside and Spencer's Happy Ties cards, omitted here as they are decades-old and no longer serviced as reward products.)
